lib.label: Repo-relative directory of the ui lib that gets the directive (e.g. libs/web/catalog/ui)

name.label: Directive name, dash-case (e.g. highlight); the selector is [<prefix>Highlight] and the class <Prefix>Highlight

folder.label: Folder under src/lib that holds the files, dash-case. Omit to use the name; set it to group related artifacts (e.g. experiments for a service and its directive)

description: New standalone Angular attribute directive in a ui lib: <lib>/src/lib/<name>/<name>.ts and .spec.ts (no class suffix), exported from the lib barrel. The selector is [<prefix><Name>] in camelCase with the lib's prefix and the class is <Prefix><Name>, as the lint rules require. The spec applies it to a host element. Gives the lib a unit-test target when it has none. Replaces nx g @nx/angular:directive.
